errors.evidence: The y-axis is labeled "Risk Index Score," not "Risk Score."

errors.text_span: етикетите са разположени през интервали от 200
errors.evidence: The labels on the y-axis are not at intervals of 200. The tick marks are at 400, 900, 1400, 1900, 2400, 2900, which corresponds to an interval of 500.
For the Bulgaria line, the value in 1990 is not around 1900; it is significantly higher, at approximately 2100-2200.

errors.text_span: През 1995 година линията достига минимална стойност от 1500
errors.evidence: The value for Bulgaria in 1995 is not 1500; it is a local peak around 2200. Additionally, this is not the minimum value for the series.

errors.text_span: отново се увеличава до 2100 през 2000 година
errors.evidence: The value for Bulgaria in 2000 is not 2100; it is much lower, at approximately 1700-1750.
The final value for the Bulgaria line in 2015 is not approximately 900; it is closer to 1100.

errors.text_span: Червената линия, обозначена като “OECD”, започва при стойност около 400 през 1980 година
errors.evidence: The OECD line does not start at 400 in 1980. It starts at a value of approximately 1000.
The OECD line in 1985 is not at 600. Its value is approximately 1000.
The final value for the OECD line in 2015 is approximately 900, not 800. Also, the line does not simply decrease from 1985 to 2015; it fluctuates.
